entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker who prefers to scheme from the sidelines and has plans for years to come.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker whose sanity degenerates; Bolas's instrument on Zendikar.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane whose mana Bolas fed on.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane where Bolas was active through Sarkhan.

entities.name: the Mending
entities.description: The event after which planeswalkers' minds and bodies began to crumble.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane made of metal, suffused with artifacts and orbited by mana suns.

events.summary: Bolas feeds on Alara's mana to hold off the post-Mending crumbling of his mind and body.
events.quote: By feeding on the power of Alara's mana, Bolas forestalled the post-Mending crumbling of his mind and body for a time

relations.quote: he was active there through his instrument Sarkhan the Mad
